subject: chemistry
title: Compounds (part 4)
textbookText: ii. Negative resonance effect (-R) If an electron withdraws from the carbon of the functional group or main molecule of the organic compound by the process of delocalization, it is considered as negative resonance effect (-R). Consequently, electron density of the molecule decreases. The groups that show negative resonance effect (-R) are –NO2, >C=O, CHO, -COOH, -C≡N. In aromatic hydrocarbons, due to –R effect, electron density of ortho and para carbons is decreased.
